Migration and development

Migration is closely connected to differences in labour demand, wages, household resources, and economic opportunities. It can change the allocation of workers across regions and sectors and affect both migrants and their families.

Research on migration also considers the costs of moving and the role of networks and information. These factors can determine who migrates, where people move, and what kinds of employment they obtain.
